title: Spectral Gap Bounds for Langevin Dynamics in Mixed Spherical Spin Glasses
summary: We prove lower bounds on the relaxation time $1/γ_{N,β}$ of Langevin dynamics for mixed spherical spin glasses with even mixture $ξ(x)=\sum_{p\ge4}γ_p^2x^p$, under a one-step-replica-symmetry-breaking-type standing assumption of strict threshold separation $E_0(ξ)>E_1(ξ)>E_2(ξ)$; the pure spherical $p$-spin glass with even $p\ge4$, for which the assumption is a theorem, is recovered as a corollary.
